test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect narration of the given sentence.**

The coach said to her, “First relax thoroughly before the game starts.”

options.text: The coach advised her first to relax thoroughly before the game started.
The coach asked her to relax before the game starts thoroughly.
The coach asked her to relax thoroughly before the game started first
The coach told her that she should first relax thoroughly before the game started.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The coach advised her first to relax thoroughly before the game started. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **direct speech **and we need to convert it to **indirect speech.**
 
• When we change an **direct speech** into **indirect speech**, we must follow these **rules**:
 
• The given sentence is also an imperative sentence.
 
 
• The sense of command, order, advise, request and suggest is implied in the reported clause of the sentence. We have to change the reporting verb in accordance with the mood of the sentence. 
 
• In the imperative sentence the reporting verb ‘said’, ‘said to’, ‘told’ changes to advised, command, requested, ordered, etc. depending on the mood of the sentence. 
 
• Imperative sentence changes to statement form [direct to indirect speech]
 
• We use '**to**' to connect the two clauses in the indirect speech part. when **advising **something to someone.
 
 
 
• **Example -** *Mother said to me, “Think before you act.” (Direct)*

* Mother advised me to think before I act. (Indirect) *

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

**Correct Indirect speech: ***The coach advised her first to relax thoroughly before the game started. *
